row.notes: entrant_%d row access in the entrant-list parser m1-verify: copies a key struct and appends _<index>; no row access | #563 proposed the name Gdb_MakeIndexedKey | myteam-heal 2026-11-13: the built key (row) gets [row+0x200] = -1 (0x1445a2a80) and [row+0x204] = 1 (0x1445a2a8a) for every index: +0x200 is the row count a later Gdb_Init_TableCursor on that key would cache, not the row index. Gdb_Find_RowByLabel's hit returns this key, so a found row also reads -1 at +0x200; only its miss path writes 'Invalid' at +0 and +0x100 (0x1445a2cc5) with +0x204 = 0 (0x1445a2cb1). Launcher 1.9.21's My Team vehicle base guard tested +0x200 < 0 and so skipped every saved My Team car, found or not (silversquared, Sandycoolboi, Happy & Lovely, Kokoslaw2); 1.9.22 still skipped every myteam_mes_ car (JamesF1's myteam_mes_custom_2 with More Engine Suppliers on). A found/missing test is +0x204 (1 found, 0 miss) or the 'Invalid' path.
